verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Supermemory functioning as an MCP *server* that other agents (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) connect to for memory/context — not Supermemory acting as an MCP *client* that ingests external MCP servers' tools. Its 'connectors' (Google Drive, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) are data-sync integrations, not MCP tool-plugging. No evidence shows a user adding third-party MCP servers to Supermemory so it can call their tools.
